input: We're working on a multi-chip SoC design using CHI C2C for inter-die coherency. VM workloads on chip 0 need to access device memory on chip 1 via IOMMU passthrough. We see GPT faults when the Realm VM tries to access cross-chip memory. The GPC on chip 1 rejects the access. How do we synchronize Granule Protection Tables across chiplets for ARM CCA Realm support?
